description:
Protect what you share. MaskID helps you prepare safer copies of documents, photos, IDs and PDFs before sending them to another person, company or service.

A landlord may need proof of identity, but not every number on your ID. A recruiter may need a certificate, but not your home address or signature. MaskID gives you control before you tap Share.

HIDE SENSITIVE INFORMATION
Cover any detail the recipient does not need. Draw and adjust masks manually, or use on-device OCR suggestions to help locate identity numbers, email addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and payment-card numbers. You decide what stays visible and what does not.

ADD PURPOSE-SPECIFIC WATERMARKS
Mark the copy with its intended use before sending it. Add a custom watermark such as “For rental verification only”, a recipient name or a purpose to make the shared copy easier to identify and harder to reuse outside its intended purpose.

CREATE A SAFER COPY
MaskID keeps your original separate from the protected copy you export. Protected PDF pages are rasterized and the exported PDF is checked for residual selectable text in masked regions. Supported image exports can remove sensitive EXIF and GPS metadata.

FIND SENSITIVE DATA FASTER
On-device OCR can suggest areas that may contain identity and document numbers, email addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and payment-card numbers. Suggestions speed up review; you always confirm what should be hidden before export.

BUILT FOR REAL-LIFE SHARING
Use MaskID for rental and housing applications, job applications, travel, hotel bookings, account verification, banking, insurance, healthcare, administrative, legal and professional processes. Import from Files, Photos, the camera, the document scanner or the Share Extension. Work with individual files or process multiple documents with reusable templates.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Document processing and OCR run entirely on your device. No account required. MaskID includes an encrypted local library, a device-authenticated encrypted Vault and optional private iCloud sync.

DESIGNED FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Use the adaptive iPhone and iPad workspace in portrait or landscape with keyboard navigation, VoiceOver and Dynamic Type.

WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
Add the MaskID protection-status widget to your iPhone or iPad Home Screen to see aggregate protection totals and start a new capture. Use Siri and Apple Shortcuts to start a document-protection workflow or open the secure Vault. Opening the Vault always returns to MaskID and still requires device authentication.

You stay in control. Review every page before sharing and confirm that all sensitive details are covered.
